correctness.rationale: For N≥2, θ>0, each B_i is an independent Bernoulli root choice with p_i=θ/(θ+i−1); root-child components form Ewens θ blocks, and H_N=1 exactly when no singleton. Coupling a forced B_i=1 cut configuration to B_i=0 merges its component with its potential parent and cannot create singleton blocks; a positive-probability choice makes strict improvement, giving Cov(B_i,H_N)<0. Exact Ewens probability of singleton label i and residual λ_(N−1) gives lower bound for Δ, while the predecessor-component singleton contribution gives the stated upper correction θ(θ+i−1)/((θ+N−1)(θ+i−2)). Factorial moments of Ewens singleton counts tend θ^r, so λ→e^(−θ); substituting bounds yields uniform N Cov→−θ e^(−θ) for i≥εN, and summing error O_θ(log N/N) yields Cov(K_N,H_N)→−θe^(−θ). Independent exact parent enumeration at N=4 θ=1/2, N=6 θ=1, N=7 θ=2 checked signs and finite statements. θ remains fixed in asymptotic; no early-index uniformity asserted.
